summary: HR Manager with over 10 years of progressive experience in employee relations, labor negotiations, and benefits administration, primarily within mid-size regional firms. Skilled at aligning HR strategy with business goals while ensuring compliance and fostering positive employee engagement.

experience.title: HR Manager
experience.employer: a mid-size regional healthcare services firm
bullets: Serve as primary liaison between management and 600+ employees, resolving complex employee relations issues and interpreting HR policies, reducing grievance escalations by 25% year-over-year.
Plan and direct work activities of a team of 5 HR generalists, overseeing employment, compensation, labor relations, and employee engagement functions.
Administer disciplinary procedures and conduct sensitive termination meetings, ensuring consistent application of policy and minimizing legal risk.
Represent the organization at unemployment hearings and personnel-related investigations, achieving favorable outcomes in 90% of cases.
Advise managers on equal employment opportunity and harassment prevention, leading mandatory training that lowered reported incidents by 30%.
Analyze and modify compensation and benefits policies annually, benchmarking against regional market data to maintain competitiveness and legal compliance.

experience.title: HR Business Partner
bullets: Partnered with operations leaders to address staffing shortfalls, redesigning recruiting workflows that cut time-to-fill by 20% across production roles.
Negotiated and administered collective bargaining agreement provisions, participating in labor-management meetings and interpreting contract language for supervisors.
Conducted new employee orientation for 200+ hires annually, improving 90-day retention by 15% through structured onboarding and mentorship.
Refereed workplace disputes and mediated conflicts between employees and supervisors, resolving 85% of cases without formal escalation.
Monitored HR metrics and advised management on policy changes related to leave, attendance, and performance management.

experience.title: HR Generalist
experience.employer: a mid-size regional financial services firm
bullets: Handled employee questions regarding contracts, benefits, and workplace policies, serving as first point of contact for a 300-person workforce.
Supported compensation analyses and annual benefits enrollment, ensuring accurate data and timely communication to employees.
Assisted in disciplinary meetings and documentation, maintaining confidentiality and adherence to legal requirements.
Coordinated new employee orientation sessions and tracked completion of required compliance training.
Maintained HRIS records and generated reports on turnover, headcount, and equal employment opportunity statistics for leadership review.

experience.title: HR Assistant
bullets: Provided administrative support for recruitment, onboarding, and benefits administration, processing new hire paperwork for 100+ employees.
Responded to routine employee inquiries regarding policies, payroll, and leave balances, escalating complex issues to senior HR staff.
Assisted with scheduling interviews, maintaining personnel files, and preparing materials for orientation sessions.
Helped track compliance with employment regulations and supported HR manager in preparing for audits.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Business Administration
